verses.en: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
verses.pt: Meus irmãos, não sejais muitos de vós mestres, sabendo que receberemos um juízo mais severo.
verses.en_web: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
verses.en_bbe: Do not all be teachers, my brothers, because we teachers will be judged more hardly than others.

verses.en: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
verses.pt: Pois todos tropeçamos em muitas coisas. Se alguém não tropeça em palavra, esse é homem perfeito, e capaz de refrear também todo o corpo.
verses.en_web: For in many things we all stumble. If anyone doesn’t stumble in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.
verses.en_bbe: For we all go wrong in a number of things. If a man never makes a slip in his talk, then he is a complete man and able to keep all his body in control.

verses.en: Behold, we put bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
verses.pt: Ora, se pomos freios na boca dos cavalos, para que nos obedeçam, então conseguimos dirigir todo o seu corpo.
verses.en_web: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
verses.en_bbe: Now if we put bits of iron into horses' mouths so that they may be guided by us, we have complete control of their bodies.

verses.en: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
verses.pt: Vede também os navios que, embora tão grandes e levados por impetuosos ventos, com um pequenino leme se voltam para onde quer o impulso do timoneiro.
verses.en_web: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
verses.en_bbe: And again ships, though they are so great and are moved by violent winds, are turned by a very small guiding-blade, at the impulse of the man who is using it.

verses.en: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
verses.pt: Assim também a língua é um pequeno membro, e se gaba de grandes coisas. Vede quão grande bosque um tão pequeno fogo incendeia.
verses.en_web: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
verses.en_bbe: Even so the tongue is a small part of the body, but it takes credit for great things. How much wood may be lighted by a very little fire!

verses.en: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
verses.pt: A língua também é um fogo; sim, a língua, qual mundo de iniqüidade, colocada entre os nossos membros, contamina todo o corpo, e inflama o curso da natureza, sendo por sua vez inflamada pelo inferno.
verses.en_web: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
verses.en_bbe: And the tongue is a fire; it is the power of evil placed in our bodies, making all the body unclean, putting the wheel of life on fire, and getting its fire from hell.

verses.en: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
verses.pt: Pois toda espécie tanto de feras, como de aves, tanto de répteis como de animais do mar, se doma, e tem sido domada pelo gênero humano;
verses.en_web: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;
verses.en_bbe: For every sort of beast and bird and every living thing on earth and in the sea has been controlled by man and is under his authority;

verses.en: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.pt: mas a língua, nenhum homem a pode domar. É um mal irrefreável; está cheia de peçonha mortal.
verses.en_web: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.en_bbe: But the tongue may not be controlled by man; it is an unresting evil, it is full of the poison of death.

verses.en: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
verses.pt: Com ela bendizemos ao Senhor e Pai, e com ela amaldiçoamos os homens, feitos à semelhança de Deus.
verses.en_web: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who are made in the image of God.
verses.en_bbe: With it we give praise to our Lord and Father; and with it we put a curse on men who are made in God's image.

verses.en: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verses.pt: Da mesma boca procede bênção e maldição. Não convém, meus irmãos, que se faça assim.
verses.en_web: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
verses.en_bbe: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, it is not right for these things to be so.

verses.en: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
verses.pt: Porventura a fonte deita da mesma abertura água doce e água amargosa?
verses.en_web: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
verses.en_bbe: Does the fountain send from the same outlet sweet and bitter water?

verses.en: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
verses.pt: Meus irmãos, pode acaso uma figueira produzir azeitonas, ou uma videira figos? Nem tampouco pode uma fonte de água salgada dar água doce.
verses.en_web: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
verses.en_bbe: Is a fig-tree able to give us olives, my brothers, or do we get figs from a vine, or sweet water from the salt sea?

verses.en: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
verses.pt: Quem dentre vós é sábio e entendido? Mostre pelo seu bom procedimento as suas obras em mansidão de sabedoria.
verses.en_web: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
verses.en_bbe: Who has wisdom and good sense among you? let him make his works clear by a life of gentle wisdom.

verses.en: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
verses.pt: Mas, se tendes amargo ciúme e sentimento faccioso em vosso coração, não vos glorieis, nem mintais contra a verdade.
verses.en_web: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
verses.en_bbe: But if you have bitter envy in your heart and the desire to get the better of others, have no pride in this, talking falsely against what is true.

verses.en: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
verses.pt: Essa não é a sabedoria que vem do alto, mas é terrena, animal e diabólica.
verses.en_web: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
verses.en_bbe: This wisdom is not from heaven, but is of the earth and the flesh and the Evil One.

verses.en: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
verses.pt: Porque onde há ciúme e sentimento faccioso, aí há confusão e toda obra má.
verses.en_web: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
verses.en_bbe: For where envy is, and the desire to get the better of others, there is no order, but every sort of evil-doing.

verses.en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.pt: Mas a sabedoria que vem do alto é, primeiramente, pura, depois pacífica, moderada, tratável, cheia de misericórdia e de bons frutos, sem parcialidade, e sem hipocrisia.
verses.en_web: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.en_bbe: But the wisdom which is from heaven is first holy, then gentle, readily giving way in argument, full of peace and mercy and good works, not doubting, not seeming other than it is.

verses.en: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
verses.pt: Ora, o fruto da justiça semeia-se em paz para aqueles que promovem a paz.
verses.en_web: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
verses.en_bbe: And the fruit of righteousness is planted in peace for those who make peace.
